fields.description: Weekly issue containing editorials and local commentary on Miami and South Florida civic affairs, including calls for legislative reform ahead of the April session; criticism of public utilities and Miami Beach telephone service and billing; discussion of a city agreement affecting motor bus operations and municipal regulatory power; coverage of proposed Florida East Coast Railway freight and passenger rate reductions and the Miami Chamber of Commerce position; notes on real estate prospects, harbor cleanup, and local events and entertainment listings (including Miami Beach Garden Theatre benefit and racing at Hialeah Park and Biscayne Kennel Club).
